result: Donor cashback source, template and stylesheet were already byte-identical to the 1.12.2 base. They were copied exactly; the existing single homepage call was preserved. No runtime changes were required or made.
test_environment: Isolated PHP presentation stubs and local Chromium HTML/CSS fixtures; not a live WordPress installation. Reward amounts and exchange rates in test fixtures are synthetic and are not part of this plugin package.
visibility_dependency: The source intentionally hides the section when the active cashback issuer is unavailable or its public policy cannot be validated. This exact transfer does not bypass that behavior.
deployment: Back up first. Replace the existing 1.12.2 Lab plugin using this ZIP; do not activate a second copy. Purge cached homepage HTML and assets. Plugin version and directory are unchanged.
